board_rule_check.source: Supermicro H14SSL-NT User Manual rev 1.0a (MNL-2821), section 2.4, p.40, read 2026-11-16T05:0xZ
board_rule_check.verbatim: Populating RDIMM/RDIMM 3DS DDR5 Memory Modules with AMD EPYC 9005 Series Processors — Type: RDIMM 1R (1 rank) / RDIMM 2R (2 ranks) / 3DS RDIMM 2S2R (4 ranks) / 3DS RDIMM 2S4R (8 ranks); Max Frequency 6400 MT/s Grade DIMM = 6400 (single merged cell spanning all four rank classes); 5600 grade = 5600; 4800 grade = 4800. Body: "The motherboard supports up to 3 TB registered ECC DDR5/3DS RDIMM at 6400 MT/s (AMD EPYC 9005 Series processor) ... in 12 slots". p.41 population table: 12 DIMMs = all 12 slots.
board_rule_check.conclusion: RDIMM 2R (which covers all 2Rx4 parts here: KSM64R52BD4-64MD/MH/HA, KSM64R52BD4-96MC, M321R8GA0PB2, M321RYGA0PB2, MTC40F204WS1...) runs 6400 MT/s at full 12-channel population on this board. The 96 GB 2Rx4 route and the 768 GB 64 GB route are board-legal at 6400.
board_rule_check.method: camofox open <pdf> --user smc; viewer page-number spinbutton; page 40/41 screenshots + text-layer read. curl=403 Akamai, r.jina.ai=empty, trawl=61MB body never delivered to client.
